nodes.title: GRO-Seq/BRIC-Seq/Bru-Seq/BruChase-Seq
nodes.scope: Illumina explanatory schematic: a single GRO-Seq-like nuclear run-on → RNA fragmentation → antibody-bead enrichment → terminal processing → amplified cDNA route. The grouped BRIC-Seq caption is retained as an observation but its implementation is resolved separately using Tani et al. (full text). Bru-Seq and BruChase-Seq are distinct named methods, supported here only at the labeling/sequencing and pulse-chase/sequencing level of the supplied Paulsen et al. abstract. Additional variant routes below are paper-reported qualifications, not branches drawn in the PNG or a universal family protocol.
